finalists.label: Aicardi-Goutières Syndrome
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including bilateral ventriculomegaly, multiple hyperechoic regions, and areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images within the ventricles.

finalists.label: Fetal ventriculomegaly
finalists.why: It is directly supported by the findings of bilateral ventriculomegaly with dilation of both frontal and occipital horns and bilateral ventricular enlargement.

frontier_selector.why: Aicardi-Goutières Syndrome is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including the specific imaging characteristics, and it does not have any evidence against it.
